description: This file is a shell script used for testing the integration between Perforce (P4), Git, and repository case sensitivity and path variations. It includes setup commands, multiple test cases for cloning repositories with different case sensitivities, path specifications, and file ignores.

methods.name: start_p4d
methods.description: Starts the Perforce server with path case folding enabled.

methods.name: client_view
methods.description: Configures the client view mappings for the depot and client workspace.

methods.name: p4 add
methods.description: Adds files to the Perforce depot.

methods.name: p4 submit
methods.description: Submits changes to the Perforce depot.

methods.name: git config
methods.description: Configures Git repository settings, such as core.ignorecase.

methods.name: git p4 clone
methods.description: Clones a Perforce depot into a Git repository, respecting case sensitivity and path specifications.

methods.name: git ls-files
methods.description: Lists the files tracked by Git.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Specifies cleanup or finishing commands after test case runs.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
